Commands.SqlStatement: DELETE from `ymia_t_pban_kaiso` where `担当者`=?担当者
Commands.Comments: 該当テーブルをいったん削除

Commands.SqlStatement:
insert into ymia_t_pban_kaiso 
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- ① 起点：指定品番をセット＋1階層目の自分自身チェック
    SELECT 
        1 AS level,
        km.HINBAN AS parent_hinban,
        km.KO_HINBAN AS child_hinban,
        km.SURYO AS qty,
        km.SURYO AS total_qty,
        CAST(CONCAT('/', km.HINBAN, '/', km.KO_HINBAN, '/') AS CHAR(2000)) AS path,
        CASE WHEN km.HINBAN = km.KO_HINBAN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cycle
    FROM mkoseim km
    WHERE km.HINBAN = ?対象品番  -- ★指定品番

    UNION ALL

    -- ② 再帰部：循環チェック＋階層制限
    SELECT 
        bt.level + 1 AS level,
        km.HINBAN AS parent_hinban,
        km.KO_HINBAN AS child_hinban,
        km.SURYO AS qty,
        bt.total_qty * km.SURYO AS total_qty,
        CONCAT(bt.path, km.KO_HINBAN, '/'),
        CASE 
            WHEN km.HINBAN = km.KO_HINBAN THEN 1
            WHEN INSTR(bt.path, CONCAT('/', km.KO_HINBAN, '/')) > 0 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_cycle
    FROM mkoseim km
    INNER JOIN bom_tree bt ON km.HINBAN = bt.child_hinban
    WHERE bt.is_cycle = 0 AND bt.level < 20
)
SELECT 
    ?担当者            AS `担当者`,             -- ★担当者名（定数文字）
    bt.level               AS `階層`,
    bt.parent_hinban      AS `親品番`,
    bt.child_hinban       AS `子品番`,
    mh.HINMEI             AS `子品名`,
    mh.ZAIKO_KANRI_KUBUN  AS `在庫管理区分`,       -- ★在庫管理区分
    bt.qty                AS `構成数`,
    bt.total_qty          AS `累計必要数`,
    
    -- ★備考(BIKO)の [LT:xx] から数値だけを安全に抽出
    CAST(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(mh.BIKO, '[LT:', -1), ']', 1) AS UNSIGNED
    )                      AS `リードタイム`,
    
    bt.path               AS `展開パス`
FROM bom_tree bt
LEFT JOIN mhinban mh ON bt.child_hinban = mh.HINBAN 
                    AND mh.KAITEI_SEQ_NBR = (
                        SELECT MAX(sub.KAITEI_SEQ_NBR) 
                        FROM mhinban sub 
                        WHERE sub.HINBAN = bt.child_hinban
                    )
WHERE bt.is_cycle = 0
ORDER BY bt.level, bt.child_hinban
